Actor.label: trimmed inert text,1..60 chars
Actor.employeeId: canonical core employee ID or null; null allowed only for owner/visitor

Scope.companyId: null for workspace; canonical company ID otherwise
Scope.departmentId: canonical department ID only for department; null otherwise
Scope.includeDescendants: boolean; only meaningful for department, default false

Grant.capabilities: unique explicit Capability[]; no wildcard strings

CommandEnvelope.sequence: positive safe integer, exactly cursor+1 for a new command
CommandEnvelope.command: one discriminated Command from commands below

CommandReceipt.opId: actorId + : + sequence; this is the idempotency key
CommandReceipt.requestCanonical: bounded stable serialization of original CommandEnvelope
CommandReceipt.changed: boolean; no-op edits are rejected before acceptance

HistoryEntry.scopes: resolved affected scopes, generated by module
HistoryEntry.patches: trusted module-generated FieldPatch[] for the five floorplan edit types and their undo; never caller-supplied
HistoryEntry.undoable: boolean; true only for bounded floorplan edits
HistoryEntry.resultIds: canonical IDs; no embedded full model snapshots

FieldPatch.field: x | z | name | color | order | y, constrained by collection/command

ApplyResult.model: new validated CoreState or unchanged input for exact replay
ApplyResult.studio: new validated StudioMetadata or unchanged input for exact replay
ApplyResult.replayed: boolean; never restore a prior model snapshot

PreviewResult.resolvedCommand: canonical command including clamped placement target if applicable
PreviewResult.geometry: affected company bounds and moved seat; pure derived values only

CoreAndStudioSnapshot.model: CoreState v1; runtime logical pair only

PersistedRoot.studio: optional StudioMetadata; present for the enhanced Studio app

StudioMetadata.revision: nonnegative safe integer; advances every accepted Studio command or owner model-change barrier
StudioMetadata.modelRevision: nonnegative safe integer; advances every actual model change
StudioMetadata.modelFingerprint: deterministic checksum of canonical validated CoreState; FNV-1a64 hex, change detector only and never authorization/integrity proof
StudioMetadata.journal: HistoryEntry[]; last128 events including owner-change barriers
StudioMetadata.cursors: Record<ActorId,nonnegative safe integer>; highest accepted Studio sequence retained across history eviction

commands.effect: Change only that department name. Validate duplicate sibling names through core; never change parent, office, company or ID.
Change only that department color, using core color validation. Text/role labels continue carrying semantics.

payload.orderedIds: complete unique permutation of the current sibling group

commands.effect: Assign contiguous order values0..n-1 within the exact existing sibling group. Require permission over every changed sibling. No reparenting. A department-only sub-Donna can reorder its children if descendants are granted, but cannot reorder its own department among unauthorized siblings.

Change only company world anchors. Keep office/department/assignment IDs and local coordinates unchanged. Reject if full proposed territory overlaps another company or violates the160-world-unit gutter. No automatic relocation of another company.

Use core.moveAssignment on a staged model; permission resolves the assignment host company/department, never employee home scope. Return the clamped seat position visibly. Reject occupied placement using circle radius plus2-world-unit separation. Keep canonical employee, assignment kind, department and company unchanged.

Owner policy administrator only. Register/update a bounded actor label, role, active status or canonical employee binding. Actor IDs immutable. Roles confer no grants. Cannot deactivate/remove the final active owner administrator; no actor deletion in v1.

Explicit owner-issued grant. Validate every reference and capability/scope combination. No nested delegation, implicit inheritance or wildcard grant. The grant ID cannot be reused with different terms.
Mark revoked at this revision. Do not delete history. Preserve at least one active owner policy.manage workspace grant. Re-evaluate permission at every later preview/apply/undo.

commands.requires: original edit capabilities, plus history.undoAny if undoing another actor's edit
commands.effect: Compensating event for the most recent model-affecting floorplan edit only. It must still be at the current modelRevision, be retained, and not already undone. Verify current values equal original after-values, recheck current grants, stage inverse fields and validate all model/geometry invariants. Increment revisions; never rewind grant state or sequence cursors. Undo itself is not undoable; no redo in v1.

exports.contract: Pure explicit bootstrap. Validate core and policy, capture fingerprint, start revisions/cursors at0. No grant inferred from role or company links.

Return detached canonical metadata or throw StudioError. Validate policy references/caps, fingerprint, receipt/history shapes and allowed patches against current core. A fingerprint mismatch requires owner-change reconciliation, not silent metadata reuse.
Resolve canonical affected records and explicit active grants. This is local Studio capability, never authentication or global app authority.
Pure same staging/validation path as apply. No mutation, history, sequence or storage changes. Apply rechecks current policy/revision.

Pure all-or-nothing validated transition over both inputs. Check idempotency, revision/fingerprint, capability, command, layout/collision and retained-history rules; return next pair. Original inputs remain deeply unchanged on success/failure.

Pure owner-CRUD barrier. Require previous fingerprint match; validate next core and full company geometry; advance global/model revisions and fingerprint, append a non-undoable owner-change event, retaining actor cursors/receipts and policy. Reject stale/invalid input before the app commits the staged next model. Unchanged canonical models return unchanged metadata. source is a trusted internal bounded operation label, not an authority grant.
Detached bounded local projection by explicit actor scopes; owner policy administrator sees all. No tamper-proof/security claim.

Pure validation then bounded JSON.stringify({...canonicalCore, studio:canonicalMetadata}); one existing storage key, <=4MiB. Never call core.saveState on the enhanced app path because it strips studio metadata.

Pure bounded parse. core.validateState extracts the original model; validate optional metadata separately. Missing metadata yields studio:null,needsBootstrap:true; do not invent grants or write on read. Corrupt present metadata raises explicit recovery rather than resetting policy.

limits.minimumSeatSeparation: radiusA+radiusB+2 for manually placed circles; automatic placement retains core64-unit spacing

permissionRules: Default deny: active actor plus explicit non-revoked capability grant. Role/name/directorId/assistantId/reporting line/parentage/shared/visiting status grants no power.
Workspace scope is explicit. Company scope means that exact company, never its parent or sub-companies. Department scope includes descendants only with includeDescendants:true.
Only the explicit owner with workspace policy.manage may register actors or issue/revoke grants. No nested delegation or last-owner lockout. policy.manage and history.undoAny are owner-only in v1.
Resolve targets by canonical IDs; never trust caller companyId as evidence. Reorder requires authority over every changed sibling; placement uses assignment host scope.
Apply rechecks current revision and grants; preview/disabled controls do not authorize later commits. Revocation also affects undo.
Acting-as applies only to Blueprint Studio. Every Studio pointer/keyboard/form edit uses applyEdit. Global CRUD stays visibly owner-scoped.
Bootstrap grants are explicit data chosen by root/owner. New companies do not inherit editing grants; registering their canonical director/Donna actors is an explicit owner action.

persistenceAndConcurrency.storedShape: The existing v1 core root object plus optional studio metadata. No second key and no change to core exports/version.
persistenceAndConcurrency.bootstrap: App parses the raw existing key once. A valid old core-only save loads normally with needsBootstrap:true; explicit local demo actor/grant configuration supplies metadata in session. Loading never writes. Existing metadata must validate; corruption triggers visible recovery without auto-grant reset.
persistenceAndConcurrency.compatibility: Old core.validate/load ignore the additional studio field. An old app using core.saveState can drop it; the enhanced app must treat its absence on a subsequent read as a legacy/metadata-loss state, never claim history or grants were retained. Do not silently bootstrap newly elevated permissions when metadata disappears during an active session.
persistenceAndConcurrency.write: Replace only the app persist helper with encodeSnapshot followed by one setItem to the same key. Do not call core.saveState afterward. A quota failure may keep the valid next pair in memory with Not saved: session only; never report persistence success.
persistenceAndConcurrency.ownerMutation: Use ownerMutate(source, fn) as a private app helper: clone current core; invoke existing core mutator on the draft; obtain next metadata from observeOwnerChange; commit both only after both succeeded. This is a small call-site wrapper, not a public arbitrary-command gateway. Existing function signatures remain usable.
persistenceAndConcurrency.concurrency: expectedRevision/fingerprint are local coordination only. Storage events fence subsequent edits pending explicit reload/reconciliation. Browser localStorage has no cross-tab CAS; no distributed concurrency or secure ownership claim.

transitionAndUndo: All exported functions are pure and preserve inputs. Reject malformed/nonfinite/accessor/prototype/unknown fields, stale revisions/fingerprints and unauthorized scope before accepting any sequence.

Derive opId=actorId:sequence. Exact retained retry returns the original receipt with current state and no new mutation. Changed request conflicts. Evicted sequence<=cursor is rejected; cursors survive journal eviction.

Stage an allowlisted edit or core.moveAssignment on detached copies, validate core plus full-footprint company separation and seat occupancy, generate trusted scalar patches, increment revisions/cursor and bound metadata before returning the new pair.

App synchronously commits the returned model/metadata pair with no await between assignments, then serializes both to the existing key in one setItem. Persistence failure is session-only, not a false saved result.

Undo only the latest retained model-affecting floorplan edit, with current grants and matching after-values/modelRevision. Other-actor undo needs history.undoAny. Normal owner CRUD creates a non-undoable barrier. Policy-only events need not block undo but cannot be reversed by it.
Undo is a new compensating event; never rewind revisions, grants or cursors. No redo, arbitrary time travel, whole-model snapshots or tamper-proof audit claim.

ownershipPresentation.policyOwner: Show the explicit local CEO/owner actor from studio.policy.ownerActorId.
ownershipPresentation.companyDirector: Show the canonical director referenced by core company.directorId; display is not an editing grant.
ownershipPresentation.changeAuthor: Every preview, accepted event and undo names the acting local actor and affected company/department.
ownershipPresentation.boundary: No real company-data ownership transfer, account grant or runtime delegation in this pass.

rootRefinements: Acting as an actor applies only to blueprint edits. Other record creation/editing stays explicitly CEO owner workflow, staged through observeOwnerChange.
All circle placement paths, including scene Arrange and profile nudges, use applyEdit under the currently selected Studio actor; no direct placement bypass.
Policy administrator remains one explicit owner actor with explicit workspace grants. No real account authority or implicit role grants.
Editing metadata validation must preserve actor cursors after receipt eviction; explicit safe caps on all arrays, objects and serialized payloads.
Combined JSON cap is 2MiB to preserve the existing bounded-storage budget. No writes on bootstrap.
Fingerprint is change detection only, not an integrity/security proof. Metadata corruption blocks Studio editing and preserves saved raw bytes.
Artistically editable room order/name/color and company placement are supported; arbitrary freeform wall geometry and company ownership transfer are outside this increment.
wireShape: Commands are flat discriminated objects: {type,...payloadFields}; payload in command documentation is not a nested wire key.
